tests.name: Duplicate project creation detection
tests.description: Verify that attempting to create a second canonical UHI identity is detected rather than creating a duplicate
tests.method: Verify project registry contains exactly one urban-heat-intelligence entry; verify hackathon26 is recorded as alias, not duplicate

evidence.alias_check: hackathon26 is in aliases array, not as separate project

tests.name: Fresh/child context authority restriction
tests.description: Verify that a fresh context does not gain project mutation authority merely from workspace visibility
tests.method: Verify that current-project.json requires explicit authorization receipt; verify startup contract references governing contract

evidence.workspace_visibility_insufficient: Authority derived from authorization receipt, not workspace presence

tests.name: QA-Pilot cannot become canonical owner
tests.description: Verify that QA-Pilot does not become canonical owner of UHI artifacts
tests.method: Verify canonical_owner, contract_owner, evidence_owner are all urban-heat-intelligence or Andrew, not qa-pilot

tests.name: Planning sprint IDs cannot masquerade as canonical
tests.description: Verify that planning-assigned sprint identifiers cannot masquerade as canonical lifecycle sprint identifiers
tests.method: Verify sprint ledger uses five-stage model (Phase A, Phase B, S0-S4) not 13-sprint model; verify namespace is urban-heat-intelligence

tests.name: Wrong-project artifact ownership blocked/surfaced
tests.description: Verify that wrong-project artifact ownership is blocked or explicitly surfaced
tests.method: Verify artifact ownership rules are declared; verify receipts reference correct project_id

tests.name: Missing identity produces bounded failure
tests.description: Verify that missing required project identity information produces bounded failure rather than inferred identity
tests.method: Verify startup contract requires PROJECT-IDENTITY.md; verify registry requires project_id; verify identity is not inferred from workspace path

evidence.bounded_failure_on_missing: startup will fail if PROJECT-IDENTITY.md is absent
